Experimental interpolation of model output — not deer density or a validated regional prediction. The underlying T04 failed independent 2024 physical-block validation (mean Spearman 0.097; error worse than a constant benchmark). The cells that failed T04's extrapolation screen remain visualization-only. No deer/km² or browse impact is inferred. Default map values are the unsmoothed, inspectable 5-km raster; optional color smoothing is display-only. This public research archive preserves the diagnostic for inspection; publication does not promote the model.

Scope: T04's expected-2024 relative deer-encounter benchmark, extended over its U.S. reporting overlay on the same 5-km grid. The percentile is relative and area-weighted, not a population-density estimate. Canada has no values. A gray cell in the original layer means T04 did not display a supported estimate, not that deer are absent. Distance refers to an originally eligible modeled grid cell, never to a camera location. Method: local ordinary kriging of modeled T04 log1p encounter rate from 32 neighboring eligible cells, then the frozen original eligible-area-weighted percentile reference. Reconstruction checks T04 predictions, not observed deer. Read the T09 methods and limits for sensitivity and validation limits.
